config.name: g1-model-axis-pilot
config.description:
G1 pilot extension per Maria's review (2026-08-10): granite3.1 alone is too old to carry the paper. Repeat the constrained-vs-unconstrained measurement across a CURRENT small-model axis; granite stays as the continuity point with the thesis pilot data. Reuse the same prompt set, conditions, and the new PowermetricsRecorder (integrated Joules) from src/edge_llm_lab/telemetry/powermetrics_stream.py. Pull models via Ollama (q4_K_M-class tags); skip gracefully any model that fails to pull and record which. n=3 per condition per model (pilot resolution).
ADAPTED ON THE MAC (2026-08-10, as this config's own NOTE instructs): 1. Script name — the Mac-side pilot script is scripts/g1_mask_cost_pilot.py,
   not scripts/g1_pilot.py. Same CLI surface otherwise: --models,
   --conditions, --repeats are all supported (multi-model support was added
   tonight specifically to satisfy this config).
2. poetry -> python3 — the project's poetry .venv interpreter is unusable on
   this Mac: a bare `import jsonschema` did not return in 180s, and that is
   also what hung 001-pipeline-smoke into its 45-minute timeout. The system
   python3 has every dependency this script needs. Left as a finding for the
   Linux side rather than papered over.
3. requires: poetry dropped for the same reason — the runner's presence check
   would pass (poetry IS installed) while the interpreter it selects hangs,
   which is a worse failure than not using it.
4. Quantization is RECORDED per model (from `ollama show`), not assumed: the
   config asks for "q4_K_M-class tags", so whatever Ollama actually ships for
   each tag is written into the manifest and the tidy CSV.
5. Models are all resolved/pulled BEFORE the idle baseline and any
   measurement, so a multi-GB download can never land inside another model's
   energy window.
